usedFor: Adafruit IO holds sensor feeds, and Conversion Chats turns “New Feed Data” into a WhatsApp message with “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Feed Data” in Adafruit IO, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A fresh sensor reading goes out as a template message through your Conversion Chats account.

watchOut: “New Feed Data” in Adafruit IO is polling, so each message follows a scheduled check, not the reading itself.
